caption: The drawing is created on a beige or light tan background and depicts a left hand shown from the back, with fingers slightly splayed. The outline of the hand and fingers is rendered in thin, light pencil lines. Covering the hand is a black lace glove, which is intricately detailed. The glove features a mesh pattern with a denser, geometric floral motif situated on the back of the hand. The glove is fingerless, with each finger opening edged in a slightly thicker black outline, and the ends of the fingers extending beyond the edge of the lace. The wrist of the glove is bordered with a scalloped edge, indicating a decorative finish. The entire composition is centered on the paper, with no additional objects or background elements, except for a small, isolated, pinkish-red mark found in the upper right area of the drawing.
title: Mitt
